title: The owner's calls on the open decisions: automation, the colony, the landing, the arena, the ending
context: docs/DECISIONS.md (2026-11-12) gathered the open gameplay calls with ten on top. The owner answered five of the ten the same day (his words kept): 5) "automation of Gunship and SOL we keep, it's very satisfying to see it happening while the tank is doing something else. leaning towards the tank doing sorties and protection missions of the yushi-rover collecting biomass. b) we need to make sure the gunship is not too agressive with friendly fire." 6) "the colony, we want to overhals the layout to be more like this https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/elevator-city-diorama/ which probably necessitates updating stalheart to its mobile version https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/stalheart-kidou/" 8) "flown landing, we need a fuel limit (but generous) and while a total CRASH is an option. Game over right away. the other options should be more limited start resources because less is salvageable." 9) "The mother is actually not the mother, it should be something else since we go kill the Queen after. we will tweak that fight later, the mechs should be more tactictal too, and the desired state is that the player in the gunship has agency doing two actions a) barrage smaller shells to protect friendlies and b) time it for a great nuke." 10) "ending will be Queen dead and Dyson sphere finished. ability to run around the finished base and observe, then start over on another procedurally generated planet. tbd." Also that day: "this is still a beta ... the gameplay and pacing needs a lot of work; we need to organize better so we can make the important gameplay decisions."
outcome: DIRECTION, nothing built by this entry. (5) The automated gunship and SOL stay; the tank's job moves toward sorties and escorting the Yushi rover's harvest; the automated gunship's friendly fire is to be checked and reined in. (6) The base's layout is to be re-made toward the elevator-city diorama, with the Stålheart as the mobile KIDOU (already imported, ?gantry=kidou). (8) The flown landing keeps a generous fuel limit; a total CRASH is a game over at once; lesser landings start with fewer resources because less is salvageable. (9) The arena's creature is not 'the mother' (the Queen is killed afterwards in the cave): it needs another name; the fight is re-worked later with tactical mechs and a gunship seat of two actions, a barrage of smaller shells to protect friendlies and a well-timed nuke. (10) The ending: the Queen dead and the Dyson sphere finished, the player free to walk the finished base, then a new run on another generated planet; details to be decided. Open on DECISIONS.md: items 1-4 and 7 (kill pay, the constraint target, the sentry cap, the difficulty curve, close early or hold).
alternatives: Automated passes weaker than manned ones, to keep the seat necessary (FUNMAP R13): not taken; the owner likes watching the automation while the tank works elsewhere.
A wreck that continues with less salvage as the worst landing (as built 2026-11-07): kept for the lesser grades, but a total crash now ends the run.
evidence: The owner's message of 2026-11-12, quoted in the context.
